archetype.title: Technology & Systems Engineering / Technical Architecture
archetype.traditionalBasis: Classical Parashari principles (BPHS Ch. 42 / Brihat Jataka Ch. 10) directly associate Mars with fire (Agni), tools/weapons (Shastra), metallurgy, and mechanical execution, while Mercury rules calculation (Ganita), precision measurement, and analytical discernment.
archetype.modernMapping: Modern occupational extrapolation: Software engineering, cloud architecture, robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), distributed data infrastructure, and digital hardware engineering.
archetype.knownLimitations: Classical Vedic texts had no concept of digital computation, semiconductors, software engineering, or AI. Mapping Martian-Mercurial signatures to computer systems is entirely a modern heuristic extrapolation based on elemental archetypes (logic/fire/mechanics).
archetype.requiredStrengths: Architectural clarity, algorithmic reasoning, systems decomposition, and delivery rigor.
archetype.potentialChallenges: Balancing technical perfectionism with organizational delegation and managing tool fatigue.
archetype.optimalEnvironment: Fast-paced technology enterprise, high-growth systems firm, or technical architecture practice.
archetype.practicalExperiment: Lead a focused architectural modernization sprint with measurable latency and stability targets.
archetype.opportunities: Technical architecture leadership, distributed systems engineering, and data infrastructure.
archetype.hazards: Rapid technology obsolescence cycles requiring continuous domain reskilling.
archetype.strategicGuidance: Focus on high-leverage architectural patterns and cultivate engineering mentorship.
